tree_version: YFull 12.03 for the AADR-derived labels; PhyloTree rCRS 17.2 for haplogrep3
note: Versioned local evidence for the paternal/maternal history views. routes stays empty until a route is checked against a source and given waypoints: with no route the view must say it is a distribution, not a reconstructed migration. parents and aliases are filled only from a tree file of the stated version; without edges match_lineage returns unresolved rather than guessing from label prefixes.

sources.what: Y tree used by 05 and by the AADR Y labels (12.03)

tree_versions.aadr_label_source: AADR .anno columns 'Y haplogroup ... based on Y-full 12.03' / 'mtDNA haplogroup'; the labels are frozen in that external release and cannot be restated
tree_versions.why_two_versions: The two sides come from different places: 05 classifies the sample against the tree this project downloaded, while the ancient-DNA panel ships labels that the AADR authors computed with whatever tree existed at their release (12.03, Lazaridis et al. Science 2022). They are not inconsistent by accident, and neither can be replaced by the other.
tree_versions.handling: canonicalize() maps a stored label onto a node of the current tree: alias table first, then membership in the tree. A label that is absent from the tree is reported as version_mismatch (kept, counted, and excluded from the default view) -- never silently treated as an unrelated branch. Fill 'aliases' when a node is renamed between versions.

y:N-CTS4714.reason: N-CTS4714 rests on 1-5 supporting sites per level below N-M1845 (N-M1928 has no independent site, N-Y125475 is a structural branch), so the branch below N-M1845 is at the resolution limit of short reads. Conservative fallback recorded by hand; it applies to this branch, not to the classifier.
